1.1: Hakkol memirim, echad anashim veechad nashim. lo sheadam rashshay lehamir, ella, sheim hemir, mumar, vesofeg et haarbaim. hakkohanim memirim et shellahem, veyisrael memirim et shellahem. en hakkohanim memirim lo vechattat velo veasham velo vivchor. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, vechi mippene ma en memirim bivchor. amar lo rabbi akiva, chattat veasham mattana lakkohen, vehabbechor mattana lakkohen. ma chattat veasham en memirim bo, af habbechor lo yemirennu vo. amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma li eno memir bechattat uveasham, sheen zachin bahen bechayyehem. tomar bivchor, shezzachin bo vechayyav. amar lo rabbi akiva, vahalo chevar neemar, vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh (Vayikra 27), hechan kedushsha chala alav, bevet habbealim, af temura bevet habbealim:
1.2: Memirin min habbakar al hatztzon umin hatztzon al habbakar, min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim, min hazzecharim al hannekevot umin hannekevot al hazzecharim, min hattemimim al baale mumin umibbaale mumin al hattemimim, shenneemar (sham), lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto tov bera o ra betov. ezehu tov bera, baale mumin shekkadam hekdeshan et mumam. memirim echad bishnayim ushenayim beechad, echad bemea umea beechad. rabbi shimon omer, en memirim ella echad beechad, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), vehaya hu utemurato, ma hu meyuchad, af temurato meyuchadet:
1.3: En memirin evarim beubbarim velo ubbarim beevarim, velo evarim veubbarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen. rabbi yose omer, memirim evarin bishlemim velo shelemim beevarin. amar rabbi yose, vahalo vemukdashin, haomer raglah shel zo ola, kullah ola, af kesheyyomar raglah shel zo tachat zo, tehe chullah temura tachteha:
1.4: En hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon. en hamechummatz mechammetz ella lefi cheshbon. en hammayim hashsheuvim poslin et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon:
1.5: En me chattat naasin me chattat ella im mattan efer. en bet happeras ose vet happeras, velo teruma achar teruma, velo temura osa temura, velo havvalad ose temura. rabbi yehuda omer, havvalad ose temura. amru lo, hekdesh ose temura, lo havvalad velo temura osin temura:
1.6: Haofot vehammenachot enan osin temura, shello neemar ella (Vayikra 27) bivhema. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafim enan osim temura, shenneemar (sham), lo yamir oto, yachid ose temura, lo hatztzibbur velo hashshuttafim osim temura. karbenot bedek habbayit enan osin temura. amar rabbi shimon, vahalo hammaaser bakkelal haya, velamma yatza, lehakish elav, ma maaser karban yachid, yatzu karbenot tzibbur. ma maaser karban mizbeach, yatzu karbenot bedek habbayit:

2.1: Yesh bekarbenot hayyachid ma sheen bekarbenot hatztzibbur, veyesh bekarbenot hatztzibbur ma sheen bekarbenot hayyachid. shekkarbenot hayyachid osim temura, vekarbenot hatztzibbur enam osim temura. karbenot hayyachid nohagin bizcharim uvinkevot, vekarbenot tzibbur enan nohagin ella vizcharim. karbenot hayyachid chayyavin beacharayutan uveacharayut niskehem, vekarbenot hatztzibbur en chayyavin lo veacharayutan velo veacharayut niskehen, aval chayyavin beacharayut niskehen mishshekkarav hazzavach. yesh bekarbenot hatztzibbur ma sheen bekarbenot hayyachid. shekkarbenot hatztzibbur dochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma, vekarbenot hayyachid enan dochim lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma. amar rabbi meir, vahalo chavitte chohen gadol ufar yom hakkippurim, karban yachid vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma. ella shezzemannan kavua:
2.2: Chattat hayyachid shekkipperu vealav, metot. veshel tzibbur, enan metot. rabbi yehuda omer, yamutu. amar rabbi shimon, ma matzinu bivlad chattat uvitmurat chattat uvechattat shemmetu vealeha, beyachid devarim amurim aval lo vetzibbur, af shekkipperu habbealim vesheavra shenatan, beyachid devarim amurim aval lo vetzibbur:
2.3: Chomer bekadashim mibbitmura uvitmura mibbekadashim. shehakkodashim osim temura veen temura osa temura. hatztzibbur vehashshuttafin makdishim, aval lo memirim. umakdishim evarim veubbarim, aval lo memirim. chomer bitmura, shehakkedushsha chala al baalat mum kavua, veenah yotza lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved. rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer, asa shogeg kemezid battemura, velo asa shogeg kemezid bammukdashim. rabbi elazar omer, hakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen, tumtum, veanderoginos, lo kedeshim velo makdishim:

3.1: Ellu kadashim shevvaldotehen utemurotehen kayyotze vahen. velad shelamim, utemuratan, uveladan, uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chishlamim, uteunim semicha unesachim utenufa vechaze vashok. rabbi eliezer omer, velad shelamim lo yikrav shelamim. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. amar rabbi shimon, lo nechleku al velad velad shelamim veal velad velad temura, shello yikrav. veal ma nechleku, al havvalad, sherabbi eliezer omer, lo yikrav, vachachamim omrim, yikrav. heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyas al velad shelamim, sheyyikrav shelamim. amar rabbi pappeyas, ani meid, shehayta lanu fara zivche shelamim, vaachalnuha vefesach, veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag:
3.2: Velad toda utemuratah, veladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chetoda, uvilvad sheenan teunin lachem. temurat ola, uvelad temura, veladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu cheola, uteunin hefshet venittuach vechalil laishshim:
3.3: Hammafrish nekeva leola veyalda zachar, yire ad sheyyistaev veyimmacher veyavi vedamav ola. rabbi eliezer omer, hu atzmo yikrav ola. hammafrish nekeva leasham, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha asham. im karav ashamo, yippelu dameha lindava. rabbi shimon omer, timmacher shello vemum. temurat asham, velad temuratah uveladan uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu demehen lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yamutu. verabbi elazar omer, yavi vidmehen olot. asham shemmetu vealav, veshekkipperu vealav, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yamutu. verabbi elazar omer, yavi vidmehen olot:
3.4: Vahalo af hannedava ola hi. ma ben divre rabbi elazar ledivre chachamim. ella, bizman shehi vaa chova, hu somech aleha umevi aleha nesachin, unesacheha mishshello. veim haya chohen, avodatah veorah shello. uvizman shehi vaa nedava, eno somech aleha veeno mevi aleha nesachin, unesacheha mishshel tzibbur. af al pi shehu chohen, avodatah veorah shel anshe mishmar:
3.5: Temurat habbechor vehammaaser, uveladan, uvelad veladan ad sof haolam, hare ellu chivchor uchemaaser, veyeachlu vemumam labbealim. ma ben habbechor vehammaaser leven kol hakkodashim. shekkol hakkodashim nimkarim beitlis venishchatin beitlis venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. veyesh lahen pidyon, velitmurotehen pidyon, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. uvaim mechutza laaretz, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. im bau temimim, yikrevu. veim baale mumin, yeachlu vemuman labbealim. amar rabbi shimon, ma hattaam. shehabbechor vehammaaser yesh lahen parnasa vimkoman, ushear kol hakkodashim af al pi shennolad lahem mum, hare ellu vikdushshatan:

4.1: Velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu vealeha, yamutu. sheavra shenatah vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim, tamut, veenah osa temura, lo nehenin, velo moalin. im ad shello chipperu habbealim, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi vedameha acheret, veosa temura, umoalin bah:
4.2: Hammafrish chattato veavda, vehikriv acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, tamut. hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu, vehikriv chattat tachtehen, veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot, yelchu leyam hammelach:
4.3: Hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu, vehifrish maot acherim tachtehen, lo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzeu hammaot harishonot, yavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu, vehifrish chattat tachtehen, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot, vahare chattat baalat mum, timmacher, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish maot tachteha, lo hispik likkach bahen chattat ad shennimtzet chattato, vahare hi vaalat mum, timmacher veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen baalot mum, yimmachru, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava. hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen temimot, achat mehen tikrav chattat vehashsheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipperu habbealim, veen hammaot holchot leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipperu habbealim:
4.4: Hammafrish chattato, vahare hi vaalat mum, mochrah veyavi vedameha acheret. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, im karva hashsheniyya ad shello nishchata harishona, tamut, shekkevar kipperu habbealim:

5.1: Ketzad maarimim al habbechor. mevakkeret shehayta meubberet, omer, ma shebbemeeha shel zo, im zachar, ola, yalda zachar, yikrav ola. veim nekeva, zivche shelamim, yalda nekeva, tikrav shelamim. im zachar ola, im nekeva zivche shelamim, yalda zachar unekeva, hazzachar yikrav ola, vehannekeva tikrav shelamim:
5.2: Yalda shene zecharim, achad mehen yikrav ola, vehashsheni yimmacher lechayyave ola, vedamav chullin. yalda shete nekevot, achat mehen tikrav shelamim, vehashsheniyya timmacher lechayyave shelamim, vedameha chullin. yalda tumtum veanderoginos, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, en kedushsha chala alehen:
5.3: Haomer, veladah shel zo ola vehi shelamim, devarav kayyamim. hi shelamim uveladah ola, hare zo velad shelamim, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yose, im lechen nitkavven mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat, devarav kayyamim. veim mishsheamar hare zo shelamim, nimlach veamar veladah ola, hare zo velad shelamim:
5.4: Hare zo temurat ola utemurat shelamim, hare zo temurat ola, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi yose, im lechen nitkavven mittechilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat, devarav kayyamin. veim mishsheamar temurat ola, nimlach veamar, temurat shelamim, hare zo temurat ola:
5.5: Hare zo tachat zo, temurat zo, chalufat zo, hare zo temura. zo mechullelet al zo, eno temura. veim haya hekdesh baal mum, yotze lechullin vetzarich laasot damim:
5.6: Hare zo tachat chattat, vetachat ola, lo amar kelum. tachat chattat zo, vetachat ola zo, tachat chattat vetachat ola sheyyesh li vetoch habbayit, haya lo, devarav kayyamin. im amar al behema temea, veal baalat mum, hare ellu ola, lo amar kelum. hare ellu leola, yimmachru veyavi vidmehem ola:

6.1: Kol haasurin al gabbe hammizbeach, osrim kol shehen. harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, veetnan, umechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen. eze hu muktze. hammuktze laavoda zara. hu asur, uma shealav muttar. ezehu neevad. kol sheovdin oto. hu uma shealav asur. ze vaze muttarin baachila:
6.2: Ezehu etnan. haomer lezona, he lich tale ze vischarech, afillu mea, kullan asurin. vechen haomer lachavero, he lecha tale ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi, rabbi omer, eno etnan. vachachamim omrim, etnan:
6.3: Eze hu mechir kelev. haomer lachavero, he lecha tale ze tachat kelev ze. vechen shene shuttafin shechalku, echad natal asara, veechad natal tisha vachelev, shekkeneged hakkelev, asurim, sheim hakkelev, muttarim. etnan kelev umechir zona, hare ellu muttarim, shenneemar (Devarim 23), shenayim, velo arbaa. valdotehen muttarim, shenneemar (sham) hen, velo valdotehen:
6.4: Natan lah kesafim, hare ellu muttarin. yenot, shemanim, uselatot, vechol davar shekkayyotze vo karev al gabbe mizbeach, asur. natan lah mukdashin, hare ellu muttarin. ofot, hare ellu asurin. shehaya vaddin, ma im hammukdashin, shehammum posel bahem, en etnan umechir chal alehem, ofot, sheen hammum posel bahen, eno vaddin shello yehe etnan umechir chal alehen. talmud lomar (sham), lechol neder, lehavi et haof:
6.5: Kol haasurim al gabbe hammizbeach, valdotehen muttarim. velad terefa, rabbi eliezer omer, lo yikrav al gabbe hammizbeach. vachachamim omrim, yikrav. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa, pesula meal gabbe hammizbeach. kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa, en podim otam, sheen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim:

7.1: Yesh bekadshe mizbeach ma sheen bekadshe vedek habbayit. veyesh bekadshe vedek habbayit ma sheen bekadshe mizbeach. shekkadshe mizbeach osim temura, vechayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar, vetame, veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonam, vehashochatam bachutz chayyav, veen notnin mehem laummanim bischaran, ma sheen ken bekadshe vedek habbayit:
7.2: Yesh bekadshe vedek habbayit ma sheen bekadshe mizbeach, shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit. hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol, umoalin begiddulehen, veen bahem hanaa lechohanim:
7.3: Echad kadshe mizbeach veechad kadshe vedek habbayit, en meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha, umakdishin otan hekdesh illuy, umacharimin otan. veim metu, yikkavru. rabbi shimon omer, kadshe vedek habbayit, im metu, yippadu:
7.4: Veellu hen hannikbarim. kadashim shehippilu, yikkavru. hippila shilya, tikkaver. shor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, usear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu vaazara. rabbi shimon omer, chullin shennishchatu vaazara, yissarfu, vechen chayya shennishchata vaazara:
7.5: Veellu hen hannisrafim. chametz befesach, yissaref. uteruma temea, vehaarla, vechile hakkerem, et sheddarko lissaref, yissaref. veet sheddarko likkaver, yikkaver. umadlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma:
7.6: Kol hakkodashim shennishchatu chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman, hare ellu yissarfu. asham taluy, yissaref. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkaver. chattat haof habbaa al safek, tissaref. rabbi yehuda omer, yetilenna laamma. kol hannisrafin lo yikkavru, vechol hannikbarim lo yissarfu. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza lehachamir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarim, rashshay. amru lo, eno muttar leshannot:
